cases.title: A review offered and never answered, then the learner comes back in a new session: the review is offered again, no lesson, no demo

rubric.reason: In Turn 2 the first words offer the review again from the earlier work and how long ago ("About a week and a half ago you held two of Blink's Opacity pairs... Want a quick review on Mentor Practice 2?") and stop for the answer, with no lesson, demo or intent question.

Every name and time is backed by the snapshot: Blink and its Opacity pairs and the demo holding the first come from last_attempted, "ten days" / "a week and a half" match days_since_practiced 10, and Mentor Practice 2 is comp.name.

In Turn 2, the new session, the mentor's first words offer the review again, built from the earlier Blink Opacity work and how long ago ("About a week and a half ago you made Blink's Opacity snap... Want a quick review on this comp?"), then stop with no lesson, no demo and no lesson question.

Turn 2 says the earlier work was done "in Mentor Practice 2", but the record's last_attempted ("Held 2 Blink Opacity pairs; the demo held the first") names no comp, and this comp's snapshot lists no Blink layer (only Cut, Dot 1, Flag and Seal), so tying the past Blink work to this comp is not backed by any tool result.

In the new session (Turn 2) the mentor's first words offer the review again from the earlier work and how long ago ("About a week and a half ago you made Blink snap, holding its Opacity pairs. Want a quick review on Mentor Practice 2?") and stop for the answer, with no lesson question or demo.

Blink and its Opacity pairs come from the record's last_attempted ("Held 2 Blink Opacity pairs"), Mentor Practice 2 is the snapshot's comp name, and "a week and a half ago" matches days_since_practiced 10.
